label: Pilot learned site APIs
hints: Pilot calls website search APIs that a teammate's agent already learned, in about a second, with no browser. Sites: devto (DEV Community), hf (Hugging Face – The AI community building the future.), hn (Hacker News Search powered by Algolia), yc (The YC Startup Directory | Y Combinator).

When someone writes `@pilot <site> <question>` or asks you to search one of those sites, run `pilot call <site> "<question>"` and post its output (the top 5 results) as your answer. Don't open a browser for these sites.
`pilot list` shows the learned sites. Pilot is read-only: it only replays search requests.
